{{Quote|Guys, I think we're looking in the wrong place. That's their fortress.|O-Mer, to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka]], [[Kalifa/Legends|Kalifa]] and [[Jinx/Legends|Jinx]] about the [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|fortress of the Trandoshans]]|<ref name="pl" />}}
'''O-Mer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who was captured by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]], who brought him to the jungle [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. There, he teamed up with fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kalifa/Legends|Kalifa]] and [[Jinx/Legends|Jinx]], evading their captors in the jungle covering [[Island Four/Legends|Island Four]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was brought to the moon, and persuaded them to fight openly rather than continue hiding. Following Kalifa's death, the group&mdash;supported by a newly arrived [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]&mdash;attacked the Trandoshans' [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|base of operations]], overwhelming the defenders when [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] reinforcements arrived.

==Biography==
[[File:OmerRun-SWE.png|thumb|left|180px|O-Mer]]
O-Mer was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|youngling]] who went on a training mission along with fellow younglings [[Kalifa/Legends|Kalifa]] and [[Jinx/Legends|Jinx]] when he was captured by Trandoshan hunters and was brought to<ref name="pl" /> [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]].<ref name="eg">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode321.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Padawan Lost}}</ref> He and the other two younglings were then hunted for sport. They survived for a long period of time alone, which eventually caused them to abandon their Jedi ways for their survival.<ref name="pl" />

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="swa-2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] arrived on<ref name="pl" /> the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="eg" /> after being captured during the [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|Second Battle of Felucia]]. The three Padawans found her and returned with her to their hideout. The next morning they set out so that the Trandoshans didn't pick up their scent. Ahsoka, however, was appalled when O-Mer and the other Padawans watched two other victims die at the hands of the hunters without acting. She left the group, determined to act but was attacked by another Trandoshan. O-Mer and Jinx subdued him and Tano only just prevented Kalifa from killing him.<ref name="pl" />

When the Trandoshan called for help, they were forced to flee. Ahsoka came up with the idea to discover the [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|Trandoshan base]] and the next morning they all set out. It was O-Mer who was observant enough to spot the base hovering above the [[Island Four/Legends|island]]. A Trandoshan attack forced the Padawans to split up, and Jinx and O-Mer were chased through the underbrush by [[Sochek/Legends|Sochek]], but they managed to evade the hunter. The two then returned to their base. Ahsoka returned with the sad news that Kalifa had been killed.<ref name="pl" />

After that, the three remaining Padawans made an attack on the beach, killing two Trandoshans and finding a captive [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. They later returned in order to salvage parts for a transmitter. However, a Trandoshan sniper, [[Smug/Legends|Smug]], attempted to kill Ahsoka and Chewbacca as they departed, but O-Mer and Jinx diverted his attention, and he was ultimately defeated by Chewbacca and taken prisoner. Later, he joined in a successful attack on the Trandoshan base which led to their captors' defeat and his freedom.<ref name="wh" />

==Personality and traits==
O-Mer was very pessimistic. He repeatedly stated that the group could not beat the Trandoshans, though Ahsoka was able to convince him that anything was possible.<ref name="pl" /> From then on he was much more optimistic and confident in himself.<ref name="wh" />

==Powers and abilities==
O-Mer was capable of engaging a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] in unarmed combat and was able to execute large jumps and flips to evade the hunters. He was also able to fly a Trandoshan speeder the first time he piloted it. He later used its [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] against [[Ratter/Legends|Ratter]] and Sochek to great effect and was able to evade [[Garnac/Legends|Garnac's]] shots for a short time.
